text:
Maria Chen: Created a compact PR to unify streaming + fallback advice for function/tool outputs. Goals: 1) one-page quickstart for `envelope` handling, 2) tiny streaming and non-streaming SDK snippets, 3) a migration note for older plain-text outputs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/859

Priya Sharma: nice. can we include an explicit example showing an empty-string response becoming `{ text: '' }`? people hit that in prod.

Maria Chen: good call. adding a line and a 2-line helper:```js
function normalize(resp) { return tryJson(resp) || { text: String(resp) }; }
```

Kunal Patel: also add a JSON schema toy that demonstrates optional arrays vs nullable: one example with `type: ['array','null']` and a short comment. keep it 6 lines.

Rui Zhang: minor: for streaming snippet show how to stop and fallback mid-stream if parse fails. e.g.:```js
stream.on('data', c => { try { push(parseChunk(c)); } catch(e) { stream.cancel(); resolve({ text: accumulated }); } });
```

Jamie Lopez: link hygiene: we reference /guide/streaming#handlers from the quickstart, but that anchor was renamed. please run link-checker or update to /guide/streaming#stream-handlers

Maria Chen: adding the schema + empty-string case + short streaming fallback. will push fixtures under examples/migration/ and a mocha test. triggering link-checker after push.

docs-bot: scheduled: link-checker queued for PR 859.

docs-bot: link-checker: failures: 1) anchor not found: `/guide/streaming#handlers` in docs/guide/envelope-quickstart.md. 2) broken relative link `../old-guides/tool-calling.md` in docs/migration/notes.md

Maria Chen: fixing anchors and updating the migration note to new path `../guide/tool-invoke.md`. pushing now.

docs-bot: link-checker: re-run complete. 0 failures.

Kunal Patel: quick content nit: change header from "Fallbacks" -> "Graceful fallbacks" per wording guidelines.

Priya Sharma: approved the content changes. left one tiny wording suggestion about explaining `envelope.output` vs `envelope.result`.

Rui Zhang: reviewed SDK snippets LGTM. tested example fixtures locally.

Jamie Lopez: approved. :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: thanks all — merging once CI completes. plan to ship with patch docs v0.18.1 tomorrow morning.

docs-bot: CI: docs-tests passed. Merge queue: 1/1. Thread closed.
